Hi, 
 
 
 
Job Title: SharePoint Developer 
 Location:  Oakland, CA 94612 
 Duration: 6 months contract position
 
 
 Job description: 
 Position responsible for maintaining and customizing SharePoint sites and pages. Heavy use of custom code. Maintaining and extending web portal that displays interactive reports. Web Portal involves the extension of Javascript front end, Java middle-ware and interaction with back-end database system.
  
 Mandatory Requirements 
 High School Diploma Required
 5+ Years of Experience Required
 Experience developing SharePoint sites (including working with Master pages, styles and templates
 5+ Years of experience with Java, JavaScript (EXTJS framework preferred), C#, T-SQL Skills, including the ability to write T-SQL code.
  
 Soft Skills: 
 Excellent written and verbal communication
 Exceptional documentation
 Collaboration and teamwork
 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
